name: avoid-ai-writing
title_zh: 删掉「值得注意的是」的 AI 腔校对员
tagline_zh: 一眼揪出「总之」「此外」「不仅…而且」这类 AI 惯用语，改完读起来像人写的。支持只查不改、原地改文件。
tagline_en: Catches AI tells like "overall," "moreover," and "not only... but also," then rewrites until it reads human.
desc_en: Audit and rewrite content to remove AI writing patterns ("AI-isms"). Use this skill when asked to "remove AI-isms," "clean up AI writing," "edit writing for AI patterns," "audit writing for AI tells," or "make this sound less like AI." Supports a detect-only mode, an edit-in-place mode for files, an optional voice profile (casual / professional / technical / warm / blunt), and an iterate-to-conver
why_zh: 不是查重，是按 AI 生成概率逐句打分——它知道 ChatGPT 爱用哪些连接词和句式。
why_en: It scores sentence-by-sentence on AI-likelihood, not just keyword matching. Knows the connective tissue LLMs overuse, and.
limit_zh: 只处理英文文本；中文 AI 腔（如「值得注意的是」）它不认。需要你提供原文文件或粘贴文本，不接 PDF/扫描件。
limit_en: English text only; won't catch Chinese AI-isms. Needs paste or plain-text files, no PDFs/scans. Doesn't guarantee passing all AI detectors—just.
title_en: AI-ism remover that deletes "It's worth noting"
